title: Taxonomy Scheme Record
description: A whole classification system: your product taxonomy, the subjects taxonomy, review-page content categories, the attribute dictionary, and external standards (ETIM 9.0, UNSPSC, HTS, a vendor's category tree). SKOS ConceptScheme. Its terms are taxonomy_term records with rel='in_scheme' -> this record. `slug` is the scheme key used as the category dimension name on other records (category.product, category.subject).

authority.description: internal = yours to change; external = maintained by someone else (ETIM, NAICS).

scheme_version.description: Version or release of the scheme, e.g. ETIM 9.0.

license.description: License terms for using and republishing it.

dimension.description: The `category` key that holds paths from this scheme on classified records, e.g. 'product', 'subject', 'review'.

authoring_file.description: Human-edited source file, e.g. taxonomy/schemes/subjects.csv. The JSON records are generated from it.

max_depth.description: Deepest level allowed in the tree.
